sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor accepts notices on behalf of respondent No.1-State.
Issue notice to respondent No.2, returnable in the first week of August, 2023.

In the meanwhile and till next date of hearing, petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.0006/2023, Police Sation Goluwala, District Hanumangarh for the offence under Sections 380, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC.
However, he shall join the investigation.
